text: Department of Information Technology Department of Information Technology bases on the front line of technological fields and takes the higher vocational education as its entrance. Adapted to the development of computer, it trains senior specialized talented persons. This department owns many kinds of advanced labs. In addition, it cooperates with some other it companies to open up a series of sites for practice and cultivate a group of brilliant students in the field of hardware maintenance, software application, software development, multimedia technical application and so on . Fusing science and technology, feeling freedom.
